messages:
maria: heads-up — ACME hit a 413 on the rerank endpoint when sending a long query + ~350 docs. customer copied the raw response: `HTTP 413 Request Entity Too Large` and nothing else.
kevin: ugh. can you paste the request they used (redact PII)?
maria: pasted below (redacted). curl + payload they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \ \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ \
  -d '{\n    "query": "'""Very long user query that includes an entire article plus commentary..."'"',\n    "documents": [ {"id": "d1", "text": "<~8k chars>" }, {"id": "d2", "text": "<~7k chars>" }, /* ... ~350 docs total */ ]\n  }'\n```
maria: they said payload size ~1.2MB, docs were not pre-trimmed.
support-bot: automated note — ticket created: #SUP-1128 (customer-facing).
sam: likely causes: total payload bytes > our gateway limit or internal per-request token/char caps. We currently enforce: max_documents=200, max_doc_chars=2048, max_query_chars=4000 (these are internal thresholds). If they sent ~350 docs with multi-k char docs, that explains 413.
ingrid: repro steps I used locally with same SDK version (sdk-js 1.2.3):
```js
await client.rerank({
  query: longQuery,
  documents: bigArrayOfDocs // 350 x ~8k chars
});
// got 413 from gateway, and logs show upstream validation: \"payload too large\"\n```
kevin: customer is asking for clearer error text and guidance. right now 413 is opaque. they want: which limit hit (docs count? doc length? query length?) and actionable next steps.
sam: agreed — we should return structured error JSON for these cases, e.g.:
```json
{
  \"error\": \"INPUT_TOO_LARGE\",
  \"message\": \"Request exceeds maximum allowed input size\",
  \"details\": {
    \"max_documents\": 200,
    \"max_document_chars\": 2048,
    \"max_query_chars\": 4000,
    \"observed_documents\": 350,
    \"observed_payload_bytes\": 1200000
  },
  \"help_url\": \"https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank#limits\"
}
```
ingrid: +1. Also include suggestion text for quick workarounds: chunk docs into batches, pre-filter with embeddings to top-K, or summarize long docs before reranking.
kevin: can we also include a retry header or a suggestion to switch to /v1/dedicated if customers need higher caps? (customer is on hosted plan)
sam: we can add a hint field, e.g. `recommended_fix`: ["split_documents_batches","use_embedding_pre_filter","shorten_query"]. For hosted customers, mention Dedicated/reserved capacity with a support link.
maria: customer is waiting for a human reply. propose: 1) quick customer response template, 2) engineering ticket to change gateway error, 3) docs PR with examples for chunking + code snippets.
kevin: draft reply for customer: "Thanks — we hit our input-size limit. To unblock you today: (a) send documents in batches of <=200 or (b) pre-filter using embeddings to top-50, or (c) summarize long docs. We're filing an engineering change to make the error clearer and add programmatic hints."
maria: sending that now. tagging eng: @sam @ingrid — can you pick up the ticket (SUP-1128 -> INFR-2345) for the structured error and doc changes?
sam: adding acceptance criteria in INFR-2345: return status 413 with JSON payload like above, include numeric fields we log, add `help_url`, add automated tests exercising large payloads. Also add telemetry metric `rerank.input_rejected.reason` with values ["doc_count","doc_length","query_length","payload_bytes"].
ingrid: I'll start the PR for the gateway and add a unit test for the validation layer. ETA EOD tomorrow.
kevin: ops note — if we change response shape, SDKs might need minor patch. coordinate with SDK owners. @deploy-bot please schedule a short compatibility run.
deploy-bot: scheduled smoke run for SDKs against staging after patch.
maria: great. I'll reply to customer with the temporary workarounds and the ticket numbers. will follow up here when ACME confirms unblock. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks all — keeping thread open for updates.
